_meta.description: Hand-maintained LIMPET tool catalog (wq#3807 README, 'Seeding the 147-tool catalog'). /home/lumen/projects/limpet/tool-catalog.json (the external deploy-time default `import_catalog.DEFAULT_CATALOG` reads) does not exist yet and is outside this worktree's allowed directories; this in-repo file is the reviewable seed. Point the importer at it explicitly: `python3 -m limpet.registry.cli import --catalog limpet/tool-catalog.json`.
_meta.scope: wq#3850: 11 tools identified from RE research, not yet installed anywhere on the fleet. None carry a `path`, so `import_catalog.catalog_to_manifest` cannot synthesize a `health_check` and `schema.validate_tool` rejects all 11 for missing required fields (`path`, `health_check`) -- reported and skipped by the importer, never guessed in, per limpet/registry/README.md and the 'never guess a path' house rule.
_meta.promotion_path: Each entry has a matching community-tier plugin manifest under limpet/examples/<name>.toml (design/wq3806_limpet_architecture.md §1.2-1.3: community = visible, inert until promoted). Promotion to a real tools.d entry requires installing the tool, then either self-registration (limpet/registry/register.py) or adding a verified `path`/`health_check` here -- not editing this file to assert a path that was never checked.
